verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is indirect. The notetaker joins meetings as a named attendee (fred@fireflies.ai), which implies some visibility to participants. Fireflies also advertises a Rules Engine giving admins 'control over meeting access and privacy,' plus audit logs. None of this explicitly documents consent mechanisms. Missing for 10: documented participant recording notifications, explicit in-meeting disclosure or consent prompts, admin-enforced consent or transparency policies, independent or hands-on corroboration.
